limitations: Exploratory image-level evaluation only. Patient independence is unverified; patient/source overlap and near-duplicates may inflate metrics. Dataset folder labels are not independently verified. No external or prospective clinical validation. Scores are not cancer probabilities. More epochs do not guarantee improvement.
